source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Javed,
Good work — you were the only clipper who finished before the deadline, and the quality backs that up. Moment capturing was on point, and the font choice worked well.
Two small things to adjust going forward:

One clip ran short — clips need to be 30-90 seconds to fully deliver the message/goal, so keep that range in mind.
No color on the captions/letters — adding color will help them pop more and improve watch time.

Neither of these is a big deal, just polish. Overall this was a strong first set and you're hired.
You'll receive payment for these clips on Monday. From there, you'll be onboarded properly with a better guideline video walking through exactly how we create a clip, the do's and don'ts, and what's expected.
One more thing — you're going to be the lead clipper for a pod of 6 clippers. That means you'll still be creating your own clips, but you'll also be approving clips from the other 5 and making sure the pod runs smoothly and everyone's hitting standard. I'll walk you through what that looks like before it kicks off, but wanted you to know now since it's a bigger responsibility than just clipping.
Congrats — talk soon.
